metadata.title: Superwizor AI — a supervisor's second brain
metadata.description: Polish-built co-pilot for therapists and supervisors. Record a session and receive transcript, report, and pointers in minutes.

hero.subhead: Record a session and receive transcript, report, and pointers in minutes. All GDPR-compliant — patient data never leaves the EU.

how.heading: Three steps from session to report

record.title: Record
record.body: Open the mobile app and start recording. Audio is encrypted in transit and stored in EU regions only.

process.title: AI processes
process.body: Transcript, speaker diarization, clinical-topic tagging and risk assessment — all in Polish.

report.title: Get the report
report.body: Full session report, supervision pointers and suggested interventions — minutes after the session ends, ready for review.

transcript.title: Full Polish transcript
transcript.body: Diarization, timestamps, fast search. One-click PDF export.

report.title: Clinical report
report.body: Supervision-ready sections: session themes, diagnostic hypotheses, risk assessment, suggested interventions.

supervisor.title: Supervision pointers
supervisor.body: AI flags moments worth pausing on — missed therapeutic opportunities, patterns, red flags.

rodo.title: GDPR + security
rodo.body: Data encrypted end-to-end, EU-only hosting, therapist-only access. Your data never trains a model.

team.title: Organisation mode
team.body: For clinics: team management, shared token billing, single invoice for the practice.

supports.title: iOS + web
supports.body: Record from your iPhone, review reports on a laptop. Android soon.

therapist.title: Psychotherapists
therapist.body: Spend less time on notes, more on sessions. Solid material for your own supervision.

supervisor.title: Supervisors
supervisor.body: Full transcript and report before each supervision session. Easier review, more precise feedback.

clinic.title: Therapy clinics
clinic.body: Consistent documentation across the team. One invoice, clear billing.

cta.heading: Try 3 free sessions
cta.body: No card, no strings. The trial includes the full product — transcripts, reports, and supervision pointers.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Superwizor AI.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes what personal data we process, why we process it, and for how long.

dpa.title: Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
dpa.intro: Terms of the data processing agreement under Article 28 GDPR.

pricing.heading: A plan that fits your practice
pricing.subhead: Every plan includes the full product: transcripts, reports, supervision pointers. You only pay for the sessions you actually use.
pricing.vatNote: Prices are net. 23% VAT added on the invoice.
pricing.footnote: Card or Przelewy24. Change or cancel your plan any time from your account.
